name: Silhouette
scaffolding_intent: The entity turns into a flat black silhouette in place, holds, then snaps back to full color, asking who or what it is

parameters.name: holdMs
parameters.description: Duration the silhouette is held before the reveal

parameters.name: pulseAmplitude
parameters.description: Scale pulse of the silhouette around its anchor (0 = none)

parameters.name: cycles
parameters.description: Number of silhouette/reveal cycles per playback

parameters.name: silhouetteColor
parameters.description: Flat fill color of the silhouette

correction_intent: Child used a wrong name, role, or profession for the right entity ('the teacher' for the mother; 'the girl' for the boy with glasses). Target that entity. Not for confusing two different entities; that is I1.
suggestion_intent: An entity the child mentioned remains unnamed or unspecified ('a boy', 'someone', 'the animal') and could be named or distinguished. Target that entity.
